terminal-full.description: Full-width data matrix — spans all 12 columns

terminal-main.description: Primary content zone — spans 8 of 12 columns

terminal-split.description: Binary data split — two equal halves with 1px hairline divider

terminal-wide.description: Extended reading zone — spans 10 of 12 (inset by 1 each side)

panel.description: Data panel with 1px solid border frame — information container

_twist.twistDescription: Replaced 24px editorial gutters with dense 8px terminal gutters. 1440px max-width (tighter than editorial 1520px). Renamed layout patterns as .terminal-* vocabulary. Added .panel with 1px hairline border. terminal-split uses 1fr 1px 1fr for visible binary divider (data separator). Spacing philosophy: terminal density, grid gap 8px = pixel grid precision, 16px container padding.
